ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white (high-intensity) regions occupy the central and inner-lateral portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the entire trailing edge, broadening significantly at the median notch and the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal vertex angle of 55 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. Frequency of variations increases distally, culminating in high-amplitude, jagged peaks (3-8 pixels in height) near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, creating a tapered, sweep-back geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, high-relief pixel clusters localized heavily at the distal tips of both lobes, representing clustered biological attachments. Scattered dark punctate spots are visible within the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; notably a set of three parallel diagonal marks in the upper left lobe and horizontal streaks in the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular encrustation and structural thickening at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several visible rake marks cutting through the white pigment on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of three parallel diagonal dark lines on the upper-left lobe near the trailing edge.
